# pve_notification_targets (Data Source)

Lists every entity that can be used as a notification target, as reported by `GET /cluster/notifications/targets`. Includes the built-in targets (e.g. `mail-to-root`) alongside user-created endpoints managed by the `pve_notification_endpoint_*` resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_notification_targets" "all" {}

output "notification_target_names" {
  value = [for t in data.pve_notification_targets.all.targets : t.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the targets listing.
- `targets` (Attributes List) Notification targets configured in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment on the target; null when unset.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the target is disabled.
- `name` (String) Name of the target.
- `origin` (String) Whether the entry is `user-created`, `builtin`, or a `modified-builtin`.
- `type` (String) Type of the target. Must be one of: `sendmail`, `gotify`, `smtp`, `webhook`.
